items.title: Proptech consolidator PLACE acquires mortgage fintech Maxwell
items.note: Maxwell serves 400+ lenders and facilitates $130B in annual mortgage volume, terms undisclosed

items.title: Ema raises $77M Series B to scale AI employees across the enterprise
items.note: quadruples valuation, revenue up 50x in two years, expanding to APAC and EMEA

items.title: Baselayer raises $35M to build an identity layer for AI agents
items.note: new "Know Your Agent" system verifies who deployed an agent and what it's allowed to do

items.title: Meta pushes its Muse AI agent onto smart glasses and new hardware
items.note: Muse gets a wake word, shopping integrations with Walmart/Best Buy/Instacart, and its own email address

items.title: Mortgage rates spike to 7.49% as pending sales and purchase apps drop
items.note: price cuts hit 42.5% of listings, purchase applications down 11% year over year

items.title: Browser-security unicorn Island raises $400M at $6.4B valuation
items.note: expanding from browser security into controlling AI agents inside the enterprise, 400 employees in Tel Aviv

items.title: FIMI buys 55% control of Israeli comms company MMD SMART for $55M
items.note: values MMD at $100M, funds go toward expanding into new countries
